criticalReadability: Essential gameplay cues are shape/position/action readable at normal detail; do not substitute hue alone for faction, threat, status, or target identity.
Low detail must preserve state, identity, targeting and warning silhouettes/markers; decorative particles and subtle surface noise may be reduced.
Reduced motion may freeze or shorten decorative motion, but must preserve windup/cast timing warnings, hit/block/stagger/death and map/terrain hazard state.
Unity presentation code is not allowed to reimplement game rules; it consumes public authoritative facts and the narrow documented local movement prediction only.

counts.scope: world/actors/combat/VFX only; counts are family rows, not distinct art assets

manualReview: MOB_TYPES is a dynamic 30-type catalog (6 per faction); art member list is fixed in this snapshot but camp assignment/elite presentation is runtime-driven.
Map features, terrain, props, gates, camps, and quest placements are generated from map seed/attempt; source catalog membership is enumerable but concrete scene instances are not.
Cosmetics list may grow; inventory names catalog containers and role categories; validate exact named COSMETICS on catalog change.
Legacy implementation distributes visuals across graphics code, generated textures, and source data; this inventory is family-level and does not claim individual raster files that do not exist.

currentUnityEvidence.limit: Live scenario coverage is accepted; distinct faction silhouette/art readability and full crowded-motion review remain open.

Frozen protocol-13 browser proof establishes applied presentation markers for Blaze, Trial, Swarm, Freeze and Last Stand; this is not a claim that all Wish-adjacent art/telegraph semantics are complete.
Real chosen/taken chest state was browser-proven. This does not close unrelated loot, chest or item family cues.
This evidence is marked ready for coordinator review and explicitly says completed server transport is not recorded; do not use it alone as accepted live evidence.
